name: Aiod CLI
description: Remote control for the aiod v2 API inside a CubeSandbox: process execution, file management, browser and MCP.
whenToUse: Run commands, manage files, drive the browser, execute code or start an MCP server inside a CubeSandbox.

items.name: guide
items.description: Aiod CLI 完整使用手册与沙箱内部系统操作指引

tools.name: aiod_version
tools.description: Show aiod-cli version and platform; returns { stdout, stderr, exitCode }.

tools.name: aiod_health
tools.description: Check the in-sandbox aiod gateway health and version; returns { stdout, stderr, exitCode }.

base.description: Sandbox gateway URL; defaults to SANDBOX_BASE from settings.

tools.name: aiod_run
tools.description: Run an aiod-cli command (exec, files, PTY, code, browser, watch, MCP); returns { stdout, stderr, exitCode }.

cmd.description: Subcommand name, e.g. exec, ls, cat, write, upload, download, browser.

base.description: Gateway URL of a specific sandbox instance.

tools.name: aiod_submit
tools.description: Submit a long-running sandbox task asynchronously; returns { taskId, cmd, status, message }.

tools.name: aiod_log
tools.description: Read logs of a task submitted by aiod_submit; returns { taskId, status, completed, exitCode, logs, nextOffset, totalLines }.

offset.description: Line index to start reading from; defaults to the beginning.

tools.name: aiod_kill
tools.description: Terminate a running async sandbox task; returns { taskId, killed }.
